name: ML Pipelines, Feature Stores & MLOps
description: End-to-end MLOps: experiment tracking and model registry (MLflow), pipeline orchestration (Kubeflow Pipelines, Metaflow), feature stores (Feast), data version control (DVC), and automated CI/CD for machine learning (CML).

subskills.name: MLflow Tracking, Model Registry & Artifacts
subskills.description: Logging parameters, metrics, and model artifacts with mlflow.log_*, model signatures, Model Registry stages (Staging, Production, Archived), and version transitions.

subskills.name: Data Version Control (DVC) & Reproducibility
subskills.description: Version controlling gigabyte datasets and model weights using Git and remote storage (S3/GCS) with DVC, dvc.yaml pipeline stages.

subskills.name: Feature Stores (Feast) - Online & Offline Stores
subskills.description: Feature definitions, entities, offline store for historical point-in-time correct training joins, and low-latency online store (Redis) for real-time inference.

subskills.name: Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) & Component Design
subskills.description: Containerized pipeline components in Kubeflow, @dsl.pipeline, @dsl.component, input/output artifacts, pipeline compiling, and KFP on Kubernetes.

subskills.name: Metaflow Human-Centric ML Workflows
subskills.description: Developing ML workflows with Metaflow @step, branching, foreach parallel execution, resuming failed runs, and AWS/Kubernetes integration.

subskills.name: Continuous Machine Learning (CML) & GitHub Actions
subskills.description: Automated training on PRs, generating markdown model evaluation report comments in pull requests using CML and GitHub Actions.

subskills.name: Continuous Training (CT) Triggers & Retraining Loops
subskills.description: Event-driven vs schedule-based automated retraining triggers, model gate evaluation against current production model, and automated deployment.

subskills.name: GPU Containerization (Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit)
subskills.description: Configuring Dockerfiles with CUDA/cuDNN base images, NVIDIA Container Toolkit (--gpus all), multi-stage builds for ML, and CUDA compatibility.

subskills.name: Model Governance, Lineage & Compliance Cards
subskills.description: Documenting Model Cards (intended use, training dataset, limitations), model lineage from raw data commit to production binary, and audit trails.

cv.signal: Built end-to-end MLOps platform using MLflow, Feast Feature Store, and Kubeflow Pipelines with automated Continuous Training

linkedin.signal: MLOps, MLflow, and Kubeflow specialist endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes ML Pipelines, Feature Stores & MLOps Technical Assessment

junior.description: Logs runs and models to MLflow, version controls datasets with DVC, and builds GPU Docker containers.

mid.description: Operates Feast feature stores, authors Kubeflow / Metaflow pipelines, and automates PR evaluation reports with CML.

senior.description: Architects enterprise Continuous Training (CT) feedback loops, champion/challenger gates, and governs corporate model compliance.
